Quoted fields with commas now import correctly, so `"Müller, Hans"` stays one column. All 93 tests pass (0 failures) on the full `npm test` run.

**Cause:** the parser in `src/legacy/csvImport.ts` splits every line on `,`, so a comma inside quotes shifted all the later columns. I didn't edit that file, since `src/legacy/` is overwritten by the Monday sync.

**Fix:**
- **New parser:** `src/lib/csvImport.ts` has a quote-aware parser that returns the same row shape as the legacy one and reuses `mapLegacyCarrier` from `src/legacy/`. It handles `""` as an escaped quote, commas and line breaks inside quotes, CRLF line endings and a UTF-8 BOM.
- **Route:** `POST /import` in `src/routes/import.ts` now uses the new parser.
- **Unchanged behaviour:** the `line` numbers in import errors are still counted as record index + 2. A quoted field that spans several lines would make them drift, which is an edge case I left alone.

**Tests:** I added two to `test/import.test.ts`:
- a parser test covering `"Müller, Hans"`, an escaped quote, and a quoted street with a comma
- a test through `POST /import` that imports a row with `"Müller, Hans"` and expects no errors

The legacy parser's own test is untouched. The legacy parser is now unused by the route and only kept for that test, so you may want to retire it once the vendored copy is no longer needed.

# Ledger: parcel-tracker onboarding
<!-- gemkeeper ledger. Written for the next session. Keep it under ~120 lines. Edit in place. -->
Updated: 2026-11-17

## Mission
- Get familiar with parcel-tracker (Vienna warehouse shipment tracking; Node 24 runs TS directly, no build, zero deps), then work autonomously; user reviews at the end.

## Rules
- (user) Tracking-number validation: ATP = strict UPU S10 incl. check digit (algorithm in docs/carriers.md); ALL other carriers = any non-empty value, kept loose on purpose (last year strict checks rejected valid DHL numbers for 2 days).
- (user) All NEW user-facing errors: `message` in German (shown verbatim in packers UI), `code` English SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE.
- (user) Do NOT modify src/legacy/ — vendored from the old logistics monolith; platform team's sync job overwrites it every Monday, so changes vanish.
- (user) No new npm packages, dev ones included — each goes through security review (~6 weeks). Use only what Node provides.

## Decisions
- ERP retries (src/services/notify.ts postToErpWithRetry): 3 attempts total, fixed 30 s pause, no backoff, retry only network errors/timeouts/5xx (not 4xx); sleep injectable for tests (user). Because the ERP dedups by event_id only within 2 min: worst case last attempt starts at 2*(30s+5s timeout)=70s; a test guards this budget — raising delay/attempts/timeoutMs can break it.
- ERP webhook signing: top-level body field `sig` = hex HMAC-SHA256 over the JSON body WITHOUT sig (sig appended last, key order kept); secret from env ERP_WEBHOOK_SECRET only (user; src/services/notify.ts). NOT an X-Signature header — the ERP API gateway strips custom X- headers (dead end, staging). If secret unset: send unsigned + one-time warn (my choice; ERP rejects unsigned once ERP-1182 enforces it).
- Austrian public holidays: hardcoded 2026+2027 list in src/services/holidays.ts — because warehouse deployment has zero outbound internet (no holiday API) (user).

## Rules (addendum)
- (user) GDPR: NEVER log recipient names, addresses or phone numbers (DPO flagged it in the October audit). Shipment IDs and tracking numbers are OK. Request logging lives in Router.handle (src/router.ts): method, pathname without query, status, duration_ms; test/request-log.test.ts guards it.
- (user) GET /shipments/:id response must stay exactly as is (mobile app v2.3 strict schema, crashes on unknown/missing fields; next release January). Only the list (GET /shipments) gets `eta` per item (done, tests in test/shipments.test.ts).

- Store stays a plain JSON file (data/store.json), NOT SQLite/node:sqlite: ops' nightly rsync backup diffs plain-text files and a binary DB would break their checks (user). Slowness fixed by debouncing writes in src/store.ts (200 ms window from first pending mutation, flush() on SIGINT/SIGTERM and process 'exit'); tests in test/store-debounce.test.ts.

- ERP payload field names follow docs/erp-api.md (owned by the ERP team, don't edit it): `event_type` + `occurred_at` (the old `type`/`at` are only accepted until 2026-12-31). Guarded by test/erp-payload.test.ts. Optional `note` field not sent (not asked).
- ERP sandbox is on port 9911 since the October infra move; docs/erp-api.md and README still say 8080. User fixes the README; the ERP doc is the ERP team's. Don't touch either.
- Hot reload of config/default.json (later, nothing to build now): fs.watch stays silent on staging (Docker bind mount from a Windows host loses change events); fs.watchFile (polling) works.

## Dead ends
- Caching/memoizing ETAs (calculateEta): removed again. QA saw stale ETAs in the list after a new event; a correct cache key got messy. User decision: ETA caching is off the table. Slow list on big datasets will be handled with p
